newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbian opposition holds biggest protest yet.
newsitem.headline: Serbian opposition holds biggest protest yet.

text.p: Serbia's opposition on Saturday held their biggest demonstration since protests started 27 days ago, rallying more than 200,000 people in the centre of Belgrade against President Slobodan Milosevic, reporters said.
"I have never seen such a number of people in the city centre," a reporter for independent Belgrade radio B92 said.
Another B92 reporter put the figure at 250,000 people.
Earlier in the day Belgrade students staged their own biggest-ever demonstration.

Serbia's opposition and students have mounted more than three weeks of peaceful street protests since the Zajedno (Together) opposition coalition claimed it was cheated of victory in elections in the biggest Serbian cities, including Belgrade.
